text: The family wants a $10,000 non-refundable deposit.
Above the reserve ($1,000 free) and non-refundable, so outside the limits. Countered: $1,000 refundable, held by the title agent, refundable only under the contract's contingencies.
Decision: $2,500 refundable deposit is above the $1,000 reserve. Approve funding $1,500 beyond the reserve for this deal, or decline (we'd keep offering $1,000).
